title: Yellow Turban Rebellion
summary: In 184 CE the Daoist healer Zhang Jue and his brothers led a mass uprising of followers in yellow headscarves against the Eastern Han court, amid high taxes and famine. Han generals suppressed the main revolt, but followers stayed a military threat for years, and the war strengthened regional commanders, contributing to the Three Kingdoms period.

uncertainty.note: Start 184 CE is firm. End 204 follows the EBSCO date range; the same page says sect followers remained a threat until 205, and the main revolt is usually reckoned crushed within 184–185.

as_recorded.value: In 184 CE, during the waning of the Han Dynasty
